meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会模拟一个由多种思维原型组成的“思想委员会”，针对你的问题分别发表意见并进行辩论，最后综合各方观点给出合成见解与行动建议。
howto.when: 当你请求多角度观点、决策帮助，或提到“委员会”、“多角度思考”、“唱反调”等关键词，或面临难以抉择的复杂问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我策划一个关于“是否辞职创业”的思想委员会。
say.note: 会召唤多个原型并进行辩论。

say.text: 我想听听对这份商业计划书的反面意见。
用快速委员会模式分析今天要不要请假。
say.note: 触发快速委员会（3位成员）。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude simulates a 'mind council' of multiple thinking archetypes who deliberate on your question, disagree with each other, and produce a synthesis with actionable insights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request diverse viewpoints, decision help, mention 'council', 'multiple angles', 'devil's advocate', or face a complex trade-off with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Organize a mind council on whether I should quit my job to start a company.
Give me a devil's advocate analysis of this business plan.
Run a quick council on whether to take a day off today.
